sql: select (select string_agg('[' || (e->>'turn') || '] ' || (e->>'who') || ': ' || left(replace(e->>'text', E'\n', ' '), 700), ' ## ') from jsonb_array_elements(x.transcript) e where coalesce(e->>'kind','text') = 'text') as t from public.ai_sim_results x where x.run_id = (select id from public.ai_sim_runs order by created_at desc limit 1) and x.scenario_key = 'festa_2027'
